title: a-gate-is-a-class
intention: Gates share common code and interface — a gate is a class in node_classes/, not ad-hoc per-ticket logic.
why: Akien, 2026-08-11, stating it as the top priority: 'our top priority is getting all the gates working with common code and config information for each.' And the shape, in his words: 'what is a gate? it should be a class, and we should instantiate a gate and an inspector for each gate... the gate instance hands messages to the harbor master at each transition. that allows the harbor master to recieve that information. the probes are on the gates... i expect it's something like .cairn/devices/device/0/tools/gate/2/probes <- and that is probably in the runtime trees added when the gate instance is constructed.' The lived symptom underneath: today a gate is an inline function inside emit(), so it has no identity — nothing to instantiate per-gate, nothing for a probe to hang on, no config to read, and no way to ask what it has learned. Six gates, six hand-tuned bodies, and every dial in the corpus is a Python literal that no evidence can ever move.
traces_to: I-learns-its-gates (the founding intention, RATIFIED 2026-07-16) — this crystallizes its named child learning-as-a-pattern, and it is the first thing that makes that intention's own third wrong-intent falsifier MEASURABLE. Also Law 4 (a gate that is a class can be inspected, configured and probed; a gate that is an inline function is policy wearing physics' clothes), Law 3 (a gate's dial is an unmeasured claim today), and Law 1 (the sieve/nest/banding primitive is block-general and already landed — re-deriving it per gate is the defect).

falsifier.proves_red: DONE when all four hold, each by its named instrument: (1) all gates instantiate from ONE class with per-gate config — instrument: a census importing the gate registry and reporting zero gate logic left inline in emit(); (2) a dial moves off its seed by installation and the seed-versus-living delta is readable by one command — instrument: that command, run against a moved gate, printing a non-empty field-level diff; (3) the harbor master receives a transition notification and its report shows it — instrument: fire a real crossing, then read harbor_master's report for that crossing; (4) a probe declared on a gate carries an addressee it was never told — instrument: probescan, which today reports the addressee as a copied module-level constant on all 18 probes. HORIZON: the delta in (2) must arise from ordinary work. A delta manufactured by hand-editing the runtime tree to make the instrument fire is the vacuous-fixture failure and does not count.

children: the-gate-is-a-class — one Gate + Inspector class at the block-general level, six named gates instantiating from it, build_inspector as the FIRST TENANT and not the owner (the relation ruling 2026-08-07 already settled one layer down for the nest). Carries the survey question that could split this cast.

a-sieve-declares-itself-in-git — the seed: one JSON file per sieve in class-space beside the gate, named for what it does, carrying the sieve's dials and its band-determining reach. NO order numeric anywhere (decision 2026-08-11-one-mechanism-per-meaning). This is what lets a bare machine regrow a gate.

the-gate-builds-its-own-tree — construction writes ~/.cairn/devices/<device>/0/tools/gate/<name>/ from the seeds, holding the living dials and the gate's probes. Instance-space, never git. Akien's own sketch, with his ratified naming (names, not numbers).

the-rule-and-its-finding-shape-reconcile — the two stamped places, deliberately apart, mismatch flagging that one needs an update. MUST declare its polarity; MUST compose the tester's source_fingerprint/standing() rather than mint a fourth mechanism.

a-gate-tells-the-harbor-master — the notification at each transition, an index and never a rival record. CAST BLOCKED on the receiver-pull, deliberately, so the ordering lives on the ticket instead of in CC's head.

a-probe-takes-its-addressee-from-its-gate — retires the copied to="harbor_master" module-level constant on all 18 probes. Smallest child, and the one that makes probescan's census go green for a reason rather than by coincidence.
how: Build a common Gate + Inspector class at the block-general level. Refactor the six existing ad-hoc gate implementations to use it. Children decompose: the class, sieve declarations, tree construction, finding-shape reconciliation, harbor-master notification, probe addressee.
workflow_and_state: code-seam@v2: THINKME -> TICKETME -> BUILDME -> PROVEME -> WATCHME(the-seed-versus-living-delta) -> [PROVED]

watchme.trigger: Every construction of a gate instance — the event that already fires. Construction is exactly the moment the seed (git-JSON) and the living tree are both in hand. No clock, no sweep. A gate whose living tree does not yet exist reports delta=SEEDED, which is distinct from delta=NONE (constructed before, never moved).
watchme.enough: When at least one gate reports a NON-EMPTY delta arising from ordinary work — a dial installed as a versioned revision because evidence moved it, not because a hand edited the tree. One real delta answers a falsifier that has stood unmeasurable since 2026-07-16. Enough is ALSO reached in the negative: every gate at delta=NONE after a full pass falsifies the founding claim.
watchme.carrier: A verdict artifact against this ticket's falsifier, carrying per gate: gate name, seed stamp, living stamp, installed revision id, and the FIELD-LEVEL DIFF. The diff is the payload — a count of changed dials would be the count-instead-of-names failure probescan exists to end.
watchme.nexus: the gate nexus — build_inspector's cairn/machines/build_inspector/nexus.py lifted to the general level alongside the gate class, by the same tenant-not-owner split ruling 2026-08-07 applied to the nest.
watchme.consumer: harbor_master — a REAL consumer only once the receiver-pull lands; named honestly here rather than fictionally, since today it resolves to DiscoveredShim and mail waits. Second consumer: Akien, via the delta command in falsifier instrument (2).

chart_claim: none, because no chart chain was run — backfilled by ticket inspector 2026-08-26. BUILDME entry gate (buildme_rides_the_sorted) is where this is answered or the chain is run.
intent: Make a GATE a thing. Every gate in the system becomes a named, instantiated class holding a nest of declared sieves, carrying its own probes, and reporting each transition to the harbor master — so all gates run on common code with per-gate configuration, and what a gate has learned becomes readable rather than stranded in a Python literal.

the_founding_falsifier_gets_its_first_in.akiens_words: Akien, 2026-08-11, mid-turn: 'what this component has learned is immediately measurable. :) a side win!'
the_founding_falsifier_gets_its_first_in.what_it_answers: I-learns-its-gates carries a wrong-intent falsifier written 2026-07-16: 'confidences never move — then it is not learning gates, only executing fixed ones, and the founding claim is false.' It has been UNMEASURABLE for the whole time it has existed, because each dial exists exactly once, as a Python literal, and a literal has no BEFORE.
the_founding_falsifier_gets_its_first_in.the_mechanism: Three layers. SEED — git-JSON in class-space beside the gate, which is what regrows a gate on a bare machine. LIVING — the graph tree node under the gate's runtime folder, moved only by installation. RECONCILIATION — stamps across the pair. The SEED-VERSUS-LIVING DELTA is the learning, and it is a diff, which is to say an instrument.
the_founding_falsifier_gets_its_first_in.the_negative_result_counts_too: If every gate reports delta=NONE after the system has run a full pass of ordinary work, the founding claim is FALSIFIED. That finding is worth more than a green and must not be reported as 'not yet'.

wrong_intent: (a) A gate consults an ORACLE at fire time. build_inspector's charter: 'a gate that consults an oracle is not a gate', and 'a learning lands here only by INSTALLATION — evidence-provenanced, ratified, versioned — never mid-fire', because replayability (same input + same revision = same verdict) is what lets a verdict be permanent in a record of truth (Law 7).
(b) The seed and the living value NEVER diverge across real use — then nothing is being learned and this is configuration theatre.

(c) The two stamped artifacts never disagree (the reconciliation is ceremony) or always disagree (it is noise, and noise gets trained away while still looking like coverage). The honest signal is rare and true.

(d) The harbor master starts KEEPING what it is told rather than being told and pointing back — the register stops being an index and becomes a rival record. Forbidden by ruling 2026-08-10-the-ticket-owns-the-refusal.
children_note: First-cut names with their whys; each files as its own ticket when taken up, and children prove before parents. The real decomposition is /chart's decompose stage against a measured survey — settling it here would be orient collapsing into pattern-matching.

measured_at_cast.gates_that_are_already_a_class: ONE — cairn/machines/build_inspector/, with SIEVES each carrying its seeding failure as Provenance, derived banding, a growth nexus, and live wiring at the emit chokepoint. The work is GENERALIZATION, not invention.
measured_at_cast.block_general_nest: cairn/tools/base/nest.py — LANDED (ticket banding-berths-at-the-general-level), carrying nest(), shake() and BAND_NAMES, with the seam already cut: derivation is tenant-specific, assembly and shake are general.
measured_at_cast.harbor_master_receive_chain: bus.drain() -> heartbeat.shim_for('harbor_master') -> DiscoveredShim -> _start_device() raises NotImplementedError -> outcome 'no_receiver'. Mail waits in the bus.
measured_at_cast.receiver_pull_face_already_exists: cairn/devices/bus/bus.py:262 — undelivered(to=...). Akien's design needs nothing new on the store side.

open_at_cast: THE POLARITY OF THE TWO STAMPED PLACES IS UNDECLARED, and there are two in the house pointing opposite ways. cairn/devices/tester/validation_store.py source_fingerprint + standing(): MATCH = the seal still holds, MISMATCH voids the green — Akien's polarity. cairn/machines/ruling/ruling.py conforms_fingerprint + verify(): MATCH is the FAILURE ('UNTOUCHED: <file> is byte-identical to intake'), because a file that must change to conform and hasn't means the ruling never landed. The pair must SAY which question its stamp answers — 'what I judged' (match = still true) or 'what must change' (match = not yet done) — or a reader cannot tell a stale pair from a satisfied one.

ARE THE SIX ONE KIND OR TWO? Five judge a CROSSING (entry, exit, emission, clearance, ticket-required — all inline in transitions.py); build_inspector judges a COMPONENT. If that is two kinds wearing one word, 'one class for all gates' is the wrong shape and this cast splits. Deliberately NOT settled from the map; it is survey's question.

IS 'ticket-required' (:558) A GATE AT ALL, or a precondition? And the clearance seat is spread across :674-760 rather than sitting in one function, so 'six gates' is itself a claim the survey must check.

THE FINDING SHAPE HAS NO DECLARATION ANYWHERE TODAY. 'What the findings must contain' is the second of Akien's two places and does not exist in any form — build_inspector's finding shape is implicit in its code. A build piece against a measured absence.

HOW CHEAP CAN INSTALLATION BE? A living dial is legal only as an installed, versioned revision, with every finding recording WHICH revision judged it. If installation cannot be made cheap, the learning stays theoretical and this reduces to config-with-extra-steps — wrong-intent (b).
charter_deltas_owed: cairn/machines/build_inspector/intention+why.json — record that it becomes the FIRST TENANT of a general gate class rather than the owner of its gate, the same relation ruling 2026-08-07 recorded for the nest. Its hardware-verdict constraint does not move; it is LIFTED, and becomes the general class's constraint.

cairn/tools/base/intention+why.json — the gate class and its probe berth land under base's charter by the nest.py/probe.py precedent (block-general machinery lives in cairn.tools.base until a real need base cannot serve arrives).

cairn/devices/harbor_master/intention+why.json — record what a gate hands it and, more importantly, what it may NOT do with it: the notification is an INDEX; the crossing stays in the boat's own history. Wrong-intent (d) written into the charter it constrains.
Any charter write pokes cairn/tools/intentions_model_compiler/recompile_gate.sh in the SAME act.
siblings: 2026-08-10-clearance-is-mandatory (ruling, cast-but-unbuilt) and clearance-leaves-a-trace — both change what the CLEARANCE gate DOES; this ticket changes what a gate IS. Not exclusive. Sequencing is an open question: making clearance mandatory inside this work or before it.

The receiver-pull (Akien's 2026-08-11 ruling: kill the postman; a shim asks bus.undelivered(to=self.device_id) for its own mail) — NOT a child, a DEPENDENCY. Child a-gate-tells-the-harbor-master cannot be proved until it lands. Not yet cast.
banding-berths-at-the-general-level — LANDED. Its output (cairn/tools/base/nest.py) is what this ticket composes rather than rebuilds.

the_ruling_that_shaped_it.verbatim: we said seives should be in bands. i thought i'd come up with a way to have both. but trying to have both with you is not a winning formula. that's what this whole system does, constrain models.
the_ruling_that_shaped_it.effect_on_this_cast: The sieve seed files carry NO order numeric — not in the filename, not as an in-band tiebreak, not anywhere. Order is the BAND, derived from the sieve's own reach, and there is no second way to say it. Akien's own '[optional order]' in his naming suggestion was withdrawn by him in the same breath; what he killed second was CC's counter-proposal to keep both. cairn/tools/base/nest.py had been enforcing this in its docstring for four days: 'ONLY the bands are ordered, and nothing here invents an order inside one.'

owning_intention_why: PROVISIONAL, to be confirmed at the PROVED crossing rather than back-filled: base owns the emit chokepoint where five of the six gates live, and owns the block-general berths (nest.py, probe.py) the sixth's machinery lifts to. If the survey finds the six are two kinds, this field is one of the things that splits.
